references.text: Holon is mentioned as one of the cities in the hill country of Judah, the same city given here to the Levites
Debir is mentioned as one of the cities in the hill country of Judah, the same city allotted here to the Levites
Joshua conquered Debir during the campaign against the southern Canaanite cities
Parallel passage listing the same Levitical cities Holon (called Hilen) and Debir with their pasturelands
Debir is mentioned as one of the cities where the Anakim lived before Joshua drove them out
